blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY — A community in Bontoc, Mountain Province submitted a resolution opposing a proposed geothermal energy project by the Energy Development Corporation (EDC) to the National Commission on Indigenous Peoples office in the Cordillera on Wednesday. The community of Barangay Guina-ang is demanding an immediate halt to ongoing geoscientific studies and its exclusion from a memorandum of agreement (MOA) signed on April 22, covering the first phase of a pre-feasibility study for the EDC-led Mainit-Sadanga Geothermal Project Prospect (MSGPP).
